title: 第7章 游魂商人第8章 继续发育
slug: 老师是个多周目速通玩家
lines: 珲伍所熟知的这个世界里，提升等级所需要的经验名为“魂”
可以理解为灵魂，但是可以数值化。
所有强大的存在无一例外，都拥有着一个强大无匹的灵魂，而对于想要变强的人而言，当然也只有一条路，去获得魂。
魂就是经验。
面板里每一次等级提升都需要消耗对应数值的魂，而这个数字是随着等级提升不断递增的。
比如对于只有25级的珲伍来说，提升到26级，就需要300左右的魂量。
这点魂量，基本上只需提着一只灯笼在夜间往路边一蹲，然后打一晚上的蚊子就可以凑齐。
是的，魂的最基本来源，就是杀戮。
把活着的东西弄死，他的魂就归你了。
越是强大的存在，弄死之后获得的魂就越多。
杀戮是最直接的方式，但却不是唯一途径，相比于蹲路边打蚊子，其实还有更加直接的方式。
去捡。
俗称白嫖。
逝者的墓前，多多少少都会遗留有数额不等的魂。
虽然数量不多，但那毕竟是人死后留下的，不是蚊子走兽等可以比拟的，有时候一两座坟墓遗留的，就可以抵你在路边拍一晚上蚊子凑的魂量了。
这是属于珲伍的快乐陵园购。
破败陵园里，盛放着属于各个不同时期的棺椁、墓碑。
这个时代最古老的那一批，用的是石棺，露天盛放。
而较为“新鲜”
的那些，则是用上了先进的冶铁锻造技术，在棺椁埋葬下去之后，还在地表之上加盖了一个金属编织的笼网。
无论是沉甸甸的石棺还是外加的金属笼网，都不是为了美观或者防盗墓，而是防止墓碑里的人爬出来。
因为这个世界是存在活尸的。
当然这些都跟珲伍没有关系，他所需要的魂都停放在墓碑或者棺椁之上，在他视野之内就是一团团拳头大的微弱白光。
只需伸手触碰，白光就会自然地遁入体内，成为自己升级面板上的对应魂量。
在宁语的视角内，她就只能看到穿着破烂打底裤的珲伍在破败陵园的每一处墓葬的棺椁上触碰一下，随着触碰过的棺椁数量越来越多，他脸上的诡异笑意就越发浓郁。
迷魅森林中，古老的树木遮挡了整片天宇，周遭是一片昏暗，仅有蕈类散发的微弱光晕在提供光亮。
在这样幽暗的环境中，目睹着辛之墓群里爬出来的生物的这一系列怪异行径，换做任何人应该都会感觉到脊背丝丝发凉。
但宁语不会，她甚至有些小兴奋，一面惊异地观察着珲伍的一举一动，一面飞速地在手中小本子上做着记录。
很快，珲伍结束了这一波陵园购。
他升级面板上的魂量来到了1997，已经足够他将等级抬到30级。
但他没有急于分配这5个加点，而是转头前往了迷魅森林更深处。
宁语同样紧跟不舍。
迷魅森林的深处，同样是一处荒废的陵园。
珲伍毫不客气地展开了新一轮白嫖。
而宁语则默默地躲在十几米开外的草丛里做着观察，暗暗揣度珲伍这些奇怪举动的用意。
content_en:
In this world that Huiwu is familiar with, the experience required to improve the level is called "soul"
It can be understood as the soul, but it can be digitized.
All powerful beings, without exception, possess an incomparably powerful soul, and for those who want to become stronger, of course there is only one way to obtain the soul.
The soul is experience.
Each level increase in the panel requires the consumption of a corresponding value of souls, and this number continues to increase as the level increases.
For example, for Hui Wu, who is only level 25, to upgrade to level 26, he will need about 300 souls.
This amount of soul can basically be obtained by squatting on the roadside at night with a lantern, and then swatting mosquitoes all night.
Yes, the most basic source of soul is killing.
Kill the living thing, and its soul will be yours.
The more powerful the being is, the more souls you will get after killing it.
Killing is the most direct way, but it is not the only way. Compared to squatting on the roadside and swatting mosquitoes, there is actually a more direct way.
Go pick it up.
Commonly known as white prostitution.
In front of the tomb of the deceased, there will be more or less varying amounts of souls left behind.
Although the number is not large, it is what is left behind after death, and cannot be compared with mosquitoes and other animals. Sometimes the remains from one or two graves can be worth the amount of souls you collect from swatting mosquitoes on the roadside all night.
This is Hui Wu’s happy cemetery shopping.
In the dilapidated cemetery, there are coffins and tombstones belonging to different periods.
The oldest batch from this era used stone coffins and were kept in the open air.
And more "fresh"
Those who used advanced iron smelting and forging technology, and after the coffin was buried, a metal woven cage net was added to the surface.
Whether it is the heavy sarcophagus or the additional metal cage net, they are not for aesthetics or to prevent tomb robbers, but to prevent people inside the tombstone from climbing out.
Because there are living corpses in this world.
Of course, none of this has anything to do with Hui Wu. The souls he needs are all resting on tombstones or coffins. Within his field of vision are fist-sized balls of faint white light.
Just reach out and touch it, and the white light will naturally escape into your body and become the corresponding soul energy on your upgrade panel.
From Ning Yu's perspective, she could only see Hui Wu wearing tattered leggings touching the coffins of every tomb in the dilapidated cemetery. As the number of coffins he touched increased, the weird smile on his face became stronger.
In the enchanted forest, ancient trees blocked the entire sky, and the surrounding area was dark, with only the faint halo of mushrooms providing light.
In such a dark environment, anyone who witnessed this series of strange behaviors of the creatures crawling out of the Tombs of Xin would feel a chill down their spine.
But Ning Yu didn't know how to do it. She was even a little excited. While observing Hui Wu's every move in amazement, she quickly took notes in the small book in her hand.
Soon, Huiwu ended this wave of cemetery purchases.
The amount of soul on his upgrade panel reached 1997, which was enough for him to raise his level to level 30.
But he was not in a hurry to allocate these 5 bonus points, but turned around and headed deeper into the enchanted forest.
Ning Yu also followed closely.
Deep in the enchanted forest, there is also an abandoned cemetery.
Hui Wu unceremoniously launched a new round of prostitution.
Ning Yu, on the other hand, was silently hiding in the grass more than ten meters away, observing, secretly trying to figure out the purpose of Hui Wu's strange actions.
